items.briefing:
Australian and New Zealand organisations are being warned of a surge in critical software vulnerabilities, with cyberattacks and ransomware incidents also rising sharply through July. A global threat campaign is actively targeting a serious flaw in VMware vCenter — widely used server management software — meaning any organisation running VMware should check with their IT team urgently about applying available patches. AI-driven cybercrime is also increasing in scale and sophistication, lowering the barrier for attackers to target everyday businesses including training organisations.

**Practical tip:** Ask your IT support provider today whether your VMware software and Windows systems are fully up to date with the latest security patches.

featured.title: Australia & New Zealand face surge in critical flaws
featured.quote: Critical patch backlogs are actively exposing Australian organisations to 85 high-impact security flaws.
